proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#11
proposed.text: Elena Rodriguez knocks Mack out and ties him up in Bogotá. After he shows her that her cousin was murdered, she helps the team rescue Bobbi and Hunter, and Mack gives her a watch so she can call them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A speedster who ties Mack up, then helps him rescue his friends.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Elena ties up, who gives her a way to call S.H.I.E.L.D.

changes.evidence: S3#11 'Bouncing Back': Elena spots, kidnaps and ties up Mack; he later frees her, shows her that Ramon killed her cousin, she joins the rescue of Bobbi and Hunter, and Mack gives her a watch to contact them. Their connection starts here, not at S4#8.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#22
proposed.text: Enoch freezes Mack and the rest of the team at a diner and takes them away.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The stranger who freezes Mack and the team at a diner.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Enoch freezes at a diner and takes away.

changes.evidence: S4#22 'World's End' closing scene: Enoch and his men enter Rae's Restaurant and freeze Coulson's team, Mack included, in stasis, then take them (all but Fitz); S5#1 shows him sending them to 2091. Cards avoid 'Chronicom', which is revealed later.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#7
proposed.text: Stranded with Deke in 1982, Mack spends a year grieving his parents. Deke keeps checking on him and brings him back to fight Sibyl's hunters alongside Deke's new recruits.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who pulls Mack out of a year of grief in 1982.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Deke pulls out of a year of grief in 1982.

changes.evidence: S7#6-7: Mack and Deke are stranded in 1982 after Mack loses his parents; Deke checks on the despondent Mack for a year, brings him to the Deke Squad, and Mack helps them defeat Sibyl's hunters.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#1
proposed.text: A year after Coulson's death, Simmons brings him back as a Life-Model Decoy, and Director Mack takes him into the field again.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's late friend, back at his side as a Life-Model Decoy.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's friend, now Director, who takes his Life-Model Decoy into the field.

changes.evidence: S6#1 states Coulson died a year earlier; S6#13/S7#1: Simmons introduces Director Mack to an LMD Coulson, and Coulson and Mack investigate Koenig's speakeasy together in 1931. Medium: depends on whether the LMD counts as the same character file.

now.title: Daredevil S1#12
now.text: Madame Gao agrees with Leland Owlsley that Vanessa is distracting Fisk. Together they arrange for her to be poisoned.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Fisk's love, whose poisoning Gao arranges with Owlsley.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's partner, who arranges Vanessa's poisoning with Owlsley.

changes.evidence: Gao decides to join Owlsley in poisoning Vanessa in S1#10 'Nelson v. Murdock', and Vanessa is poisoned at Fisk's gala in that same episode. S1#12 only has Gao and Owlsley discussing the plot after the fact.

proposed.title: Daredevil S1#13
proposed.text: Fisk learns that Gao plotted with Leland Owlsley to poison Vanessa.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A former partner, who learns Gao plotted to poison Vanessa.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A former partner, who plotted with Owlsley to poison Vanessa.

changes.evidence: S1#10: Gao and Owlsley plot Vanessa's poisoning behind Fisk's back; S1#12: Gao dissolves her partnerships and leaves; S1#13: Fisk learns that Owlsley and Gao conspired to poison Vanessa. The alliance ends in betrayal and has no stage.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#7
proposed.text: Forced by Fisk, Melvin makes the copy of Daredevil's suit that Dex wears. When Matt confronts him, Melvin tries to trap him with a second copy for the FBI, and Matt escapes as Melvin is taken in.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The craftsman who builds Matt's armor, until Fisk forces him to copy it.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Melvin builds armor for, then is forced to help frame.

changes.evidence: S3#7 'Aftermath': Melvin admits Fisk coerced him (threatening Betsy) into making Dex's suit, then follows Fisk's orders and locks Matt in a cage with a second suit to frame him; the FBI arrives, Matt escapes and Melvin is arrested.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#8
proposed.text: Matt calls Fisk as a witness at Karen's trial and reveals he is Daredevil. When Fisk locks down the courthouse, Matt talks him into taking exile from New York.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Matt's greatest enemy, whom Matt talks into leaving New York.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's old enemy, who reveals he is Daredevil and talks Fisk into exile.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#8: Murdock calls Fisk as a witness, reveals his identity as Daredevil, then fights through to Fisk during the lockdown and convinces him to take McCaffrey's exile deal; Fisk leaves New York.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#8
proposed.text: When Fisk locks down the courthouse, McCaffrey offers him exile in place of charges, and he leaves New York.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The mayor McCaffrey drives out of New York with an exile deal.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The governor whose exile deal drives Fisk out of New York.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#8: McCaffrey and her attorney general offer Fisk a deal to avoid charges if he goes into exile; he takes it and leaves New York.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#9
proposed.text: Mariah admits to Tilda that she killed Cottonmouth, and tells her she was conceived when Uncle Pete raped Mariah, which is why she does not love her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Mariah's daughter, who learns why Mariah does not love her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tilda's mother, who admits she does not love her.

changes.evidence: S2#9: Tilda confronts Mariah, who admits killing Cottonmouth and reveals Tilda was conceived through Uncle Pete's rape, which is why she does not love her. This ends the reunion begun in S2#2 and S2#8; by S2#12 Tilda is helping Bushmaster kill Mariah.
